Round off-white head, tiny black dot eyes, very minimal brow/mouth, no realistic nose, dark clean drawn contours, narrow stick-derived torso and limbs, detailed muted period clothing, soft illustrated warm light and drawn matte surfaces throughout. Bare-head-to-sole figure height approximately 5.0 to 5.5 round-head diameters; shoulders approximately 0.85 head diameters; clothing follows a slender stick skeleton. Subject occupies 72 percent of frame height with generous hat/feet/crop margins. Plain warm-gray drawn plaster wall and floor behind; upper-left key light. Zero background people, zero animals.
